Views are the provider’s observed view count, not unique people. Public interactions add likes, replies, retweets and quote tweets; they exclude unreported clicks, bookmarks and private actions. Totals are measured at the last analytics update, not forecast reach or gains during the past week. Comparisons use your own tweets of the same kind and media format at similar observed ages. They cannot explain X’s ranking or prove what caused the result.

Your Brief is set to Local only. Tweet reviews need cloud AI. Change to Auto or Cloud mode to generate this review.
Auto keeps on-device AI available for Your Brief and uses cloud AI for reviews. Cloud uses cloud AI for both. Either mode needs a Gemini API key for reviews.
